questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 2 : 17 : 19 and the sum of these numbers is 7752. Find the middle number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ratio sum = 2 + 17 + 19 = 38 units

Given total sum 7752 → 38 units

Value per unit = 7752 ÷ 38 = 204

Middle number (17 units) = 17 × 204 = 3468

**∴ Answer = 3468**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of three numbers = 2 : 17 : 19

Total sum of the numbers = 7752

**Formula used:**

Individual Number = (Specific Ratio Part ÷ Sum of Ratio Parts) × Total Sum

 2x 17x (Middle) 19x 
• Total Sum = 7752 Middle Number = 17 × 204 = 3468 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the numbers be 2x, 17x, and 19x.

⇒ Sum = 2x + 17x + 19x = 38x

⇒ 38x = 7752

⇒ x = 7752 ÷ 38

⇒ x = 204

⇒ Middle number = 17x = 17 × 204

⇒ Middle number = 3468

**∴ The correct answer is 3468 (Option 2).**

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 28°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 3 : 4, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Property: Angle between bisectors of adjacent angles = (Sum of other two angles) / 2

⇒ ∠STR = (∠P + ∠Q) / 2

⇒ 28° = (∠P + ∠Q) / 2 ⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 56°

Ratio ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 4 ⇒ Total 7 units = 56° (1 unit = 8°)

Difference = 4 − 3 = 1 unit = 8°

**∴ Answer = 8°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Quadrilateral PQRS, ∠STR = 28°, ∠P : ∠Q = 3 : 4. ST and RT are angle bisectors.

**Formula used:**

Sum of angles in a triangle = 180° | Sum of angles in a quadrilateral = 360°

 
 
• 
• P Q R S T (28°) Bisector ST Bisector RT ∠STR = 28° 

**Calculations:**

In ΔSTR, ∠TSR + ∠TRS + ∠STR = 180°

⇒ (∠S / 2) + (∠R / 2) + 28° = 180°

⇒ (∠R + ∠S) / 2 = 180° − 28° = 152°

⇒ ∠R + ∠S = 152° × 2 = 304°

⇒ In quad PQRS, ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 304° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 56°

⇒ Let ∠P = 3x and ∠Q = 4x, then 3x + 4x = 56°

⇒ 7x = 56° ⇒ x = 8°

⇒ Difference = 4x − 3x = x = 8°

**∴ The correct answer is 8° (Option 3).**

questions.question: The monthly incomes of two friends Kiran and Mahesh, are in the ratio 5 : 8 respectively and each of them saves ₹78,000 every month. If the ratio of their monthly expenditure is 2 : 4, find the monthly income of Kiran (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Income Ratio = 5 : 8, Exp Ratio = 2 : 4, Savings = 78,000 : 78,000.

Income cross-product difference = (5 × 4) − (8 × 2) = 4 units.

Savings cross-product difference = (4 × 78,000) − (2 × 78,000) = 1,56,000.

4 units = 1,56,000 → 1 unit = 39,000.

Kiran's Income = 5 units = 5 × 39,000 = 1,95,000.

**∴ Answer = 1,95,000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of monthly incomes of Kiran and Mahesh = 5 : 8

Monthly saving of each = ₹78,000

Ratio of their monthly expenditures = 2 : 4

**Formula used:**

Income − Saving = Expenditure

 Income Structure (Parts) Kiran: Exp (3u) Sav (2u) Mahesh: Expenditure (6u) Sav (2u) 
• 
• 2 units (Saving) = ₹78,000 Kiran Income (5u) = 1,95,000 

**Calculations:**

Let the monthly incomes of Kiran and Mahesh be 5x and 8x respectively.

⇒ (5x − 78,000) / (8x − 78,000) = 2 / 4

⇒ (5x − 78,000) / (8x − 78,000) = 1 / 2

⇒ 2 × (5x − 78,000) = 1 × (8x − 78,000)

⇒ 10x − 1,56,000 = 8x − 78,000

⇒ 10x − 8x = 1,56,000 − 78,000

⇒ 2x = 78,000

⇒ x = 39,000

⇒ Kiran's monthly income = 5x = 5 × 39,000 = 1,95,000

**∴ The correct answer is 1,95,000 (Option 2).**

questions.question: A group of 10 women can weave a designer saree in 20 days. After 4 days, another group of 20 women joins them to work on the same saree. In how many more days will the saree be completely woven?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Work left for 10 women = 20 − 4 = 16 days.

Total units to complete = 10 women × 16 days = 160 units.

New strength = 10 + 20 = 30 women.

Extra days required = 160 units ÷ 30 women = 16/3 days.

**∴ Answer = 5 1/3 days**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of women (M1) = 10

Initial time to weave (D1) = 20 days

Time elapsed = 4 days

New women joining = 20

**Formula used:**

Total Work = M × D (Work remains constant or additive)

 Work done in 4 days Remaining Work 10 Women 30 Women (10 + 20) 
• Work = 40 units Work = 160 units Total Work = 200 units 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total work to be done = 10 women × 20 days = 200 units.

⇒ Work completed in 4 days = 10 women × 4 days = 40 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 200 − 40 = 160 units.

⇒ New total number of women = 10 + 20 = 30 women.

⇒ More days required to finish work = Remaining work ÷ New total women.

⇒ Days = 160 ÷ 30 = 16/3 = 5 1/3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 5 1/3 days (Option 2).**

questions.question: A train overtakes two people running along a railway track. The first person is running at 12.6 km/hr, and the second person is running at 25.2 km/hr. The train takes 16.8 seconds to pass the first person and 22.4 seconds to pass the second person. What is the speed of the train if both are running in the same direction as the train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Length of train is constant → Relative speed is inversely proportional to time.

Time ratio t₁ : t₂ = 16.8 : 22.4 = 3 : 4.

Relative speed ratio (V − 12.6) : (V − 25.2) = 4 : 3.

3(V − 12.6) = 4(V − 25.2) ⇒ 3V − 37.8 = 4V − 100.8.

V = 100.8 − 37.8 = 63 km/hr.

**∴ Answer = 63 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of first person (v₁) = 12.6 km/hr

Speed of second person (v₂) = 25.2 km/hr

Time to pass first person (t₁) = 16.8 s

Time to pass second person (t₂) = 22.4 s

**Formula used:**

Distance = Relative Speed × Time

Relative Speed (Same direction) = Speed of Train (V) − Speed of Person (v)

 TRAIN Speed: V P1: 12.6 km/h P2: 25.2 km/h 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Distance = Length of Train (Constant) 

**Calculations:**

Let V be the speed of the train in km/hr.

⇒ Length of train = (V − 12.6) × (16.8 / 3600) = (V − 25.2) × (22.4 / 3600)

⇒ (V − 12.6) × 16.8 = (V − 25.2) × 22.4

⇒ (V − 12.6) / (V − 25.2) = 22.4 / 16.8

⇒ (V − 12.6) / (V − 25.2) = 4 / 3

⇒ 3 × (V − 12.6) = 4 × (V − 25.2)

⇒ 3V − 37.8 = 4V − 100.8

⇒ V = 100.8 − 37.8

⇒ V = 63 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is (1).**

questions.question: (1)/(20) is what percentage of (11)/(90) (rounded off to two decimal places)?
questions.solution:

Required Ratio = (1 ÷ 20) ÷ (11 ÷ 90)

= (1 ÷ 20) × (90 ÷ 11)

= 90 ÷ 220 = 9 ÷ 22

= 0.40909... ≈ 0.4091

**∴ Answer = 0.4091**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

First fraction = 1/20

Second fraction = 11/90

**Formula used:**

Value = (First Number ÷ Second Number)

 
• Total: 11/90 (Represented as 22 units) Part: 1/20 (Represented as 9 units) Ratio = 9 ÷ 22 ≈ 0.4091 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Required Result = (1/20) ÷ (11/90)

⇒ Result = (1/20) × (90/11)

⇒ Result = 90 ÷ 220

⇒ Result = 9 ÷ 22

⇒ Result = 0.4090909...

⇒ Result ≈ 0.4091

**∴ The correct answer is 0.4091 (Option 3).**

questions.question: Evaluate: 60 − [12 ÷ (2 + 1) + 4 × 2]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Priority order: Parentheses ( ) → Brackets [ ] → Subtraction.

Inner logic: (2 + 1) = 3

Bracket logic: [12 ÷ 3 + 4 × 2] = 4 + 8 = 12

Final step: 60 − 12 = 48

**∴ Answer = 48**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 60 − [12 ÷ (2 + 1) + 4 × 2]

**Formula used:**

BODMAS Rule: B (Brackets), O (Of), D (Division), M (Multiplication), A (Addition), S (Subtraction).

 
• Subtraction Rod (Total = 60) Result: 48 Bracket [12] 60 − [12 ÷ 3 + 8] Final Value = 48 

**Calculations:**

Evaluate the inner parentheses:

⇒ 60 − [12 ÷ 3 + 4 × 2]

Perform division and multiplication inside the square brackets:

⇒ 60 − [4 + 8]

Solve the addition inside the square brackets:

⇒ 60 − 12

⇒ 48

**∴ The correct answer is 48, which is option (4).**

questions.question: The length of a rectangle is twice its breadth. If the perimeter of the rectangle is 12 cm, find the length and breadth.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Length : Breadth = 2 : 1.

Sum of Length + Breadth = Half of Perimeter = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm.

Total ratio units = 2 + 1 = 3 units.

Value of 1 unit = 6 ÷ 3 = 2 cm.

Length = 2 × 2 = 4 cm and Breadth = 1 × 2 = 2 cm.

**∴ Answer = Length = 4 cm and breadth = 2 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 12 cm

Length = 2 × Breadth

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of a rectangle = 2 × (Length + Breadth)

 Length (L) = 2x Breadth (B) = x Perimeter = 12 cm 
• Result: L = 4 cm, B = 2 cm 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the breadth of the rectangle be x cm.

⇒ Then, the length of the rectangle = 2x cm.

⇒ Perimeter = 2 × (Length + Breadth) = 12

⇒ 2 × (2x + x) = 12

⇒ 2 × 3x = 12

⇒ 6x = 12 → x = 2

⇒ Length = 2 × 2 = 4 cm and Breadth = 2 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is (3).**

Last two digits 60 are divisible by 4, so the condition for 4 is satisfied.

For divisibility by 3, the sum of digits 3 + * + 7 + 6 + 0 = 16 + * must be a multiple of 3.

Multiples of 3 greater than 16 are 18, 21, 24, etc.

The smallest value for * is 18 − 16 = 2.

questions.question: Two trains, 130 m and 190 m long, are running in the same direction at speeds of 96 km/hr and 48 km/hr, respectively. How much time will the faster train take to completely cross the slower one?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total relative distance to cover = Sum of lengths = 130 + 190 = 320 m

Relative speed in same direction = Difference of speeds = 96 − 48 = 48 km/hr

Speed in m/s = 48 × (5/18) = 40/3 m/s

Time taken = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 320 ÷ (40/3) = 24 seconds

**∴ Answer = 24 seconds**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first train (L₁) = 130 m

Length of second train (L₂) = 190 m

Speed of faster train (S₁) = 96 km/hr

Speed of slower train (S₂) = 48 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed (Same direction) = S₁ − S₂

Time = (L₁ + L₂) ÷ (S₁ − S₂)

Conversion: 1 km/hr = 5/18 m/s

 
• Train 2 (190m) 
 48 km/h Train 1 (130m) 
 96 km/h 
• Total Distance = 130 + 190 = 320 m Relative Speed = 96 − 48 = 48 km/h 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 96 − 48 = 48 km/hr

⇒ Relative Speed in m/s = 48 × (5/18) = 8 × (5/3) = 40/3 m/s

⇒ Total distance to be covered = 130 + 190 = 320 m

⇒ Time = 320 ÷ (40/3)

⇒ Time = (320 × 3) ÷ 40

⇒ Time = 8 × 3 = 24 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 24 seconds (Option 3).**

questions.question: The marked price of an item is set at 41% above its cost price. If the merchant sells the item at 13% below the marked price, his profit percentage (rounded off to 1 decimal place) is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net Profit % = Markup % − Discount % − (Markup × Discount) / 100

Net Profit % = 41 − 13 − (41 × 13) / 100

Net Profit % = 28 − 5.33

Net Profit % = 22.67%

Rounded to 1 decimal place = 22.7% (which is 0.227 in decimal options)

**∴ Answer = 0.227**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Markup percentage = 41% above Cost Price (CP)

Discount percentage = 13% on Marked Price (MP)

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Selling Price − Cost Price) / Cost Price × 100

 
• 
• 
• CP = 100 SP = 122.67 MP = 141 
 Markup +41% 
 Discount −13% Profit = 22.67% 
 

**Calculations:**

Let the Cost Price (CP) of the item be 100.

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = 100 + 41% of 100 = 141

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP − 13% of MP

⇒ SP = 141 − (13 / 100 × 141)

⇒ SP = 141 − 18.33 = 122.67

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 122.67 − 100 = 22.67

⇒ Profit % = (22.67 / 100) × 100 = 22.67%

⇒ Rounding off to one decimal place, Profit % = 22.7%

⇒ Corresponding decimal value from options = 0.227

**∴ The correct answer is (1) 0.227.**

questions.question: If the total age of Hassan and Ali is 12 years more than the total age of Ali and Ahmed, how many years younger is Ahmed than Hassan?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Group 1: Hassan + Ali

Group 2: Ali + Ahmed

The difference (Group 1 − Group 2) is 12 years.

Common age of Ali is present in both groups and cancels out.

Remaining difference: Hassan − Ahmed = 12 years.

**∴ Answer = 12**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total age of Hassan and Ali = Total age of Ali and Ahmed + 12

**Formula used:**

Difference in ages = (Person A + Person B) − (Person B + Person C) = Person A − Person C

 Hassan Ali Ahmed 12 Ali 
• Hassan − Ahmed = 12 years 

**Calculations:**

Let the ages of Hassan, Ali, and Ahmed be H, Ali, and Ahmed respectively.

⇒ H + Ali = (Ali + Ahmed) + 12

⇒ H + Ali − Ali = Ahmed + 12

⇒ H = Ahmed + 12

⇒ H − Ahmed = 12

⇒ Ahmed = H − 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 (Option 2).**

questions.question: A and B working together can do a piece of work in 4 days. B alone can do the same work in 36 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do double the work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Work = LCM(4, 36) = 36 units.

Efficiency of (A+B) = 36 ÷ 4 = 9 units/day.

Efficiency of B = 36 ÷ 36 = 1 unit/day ⇒ Efficiency of A = 9 − 1 = 8 units/day.

Double work = 36 × 2 = 72 units.

Time taken by A = 72 ÷ 8 = 9 days.

**∴ Answer = 9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by A and B together = 4 days

Time taken by B alone = 36 days

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time Taken

Time = Total Work ÷ Efficiency

 Work (36 units) Double (36 units) 
• Total Work = 72 units Eff (A+B) = 9 Eff (B) = 1 A's Time = 72 ÷ 8 = 9 Days 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total work be LCM of 4 and 36 = 36 units.

⇒ Efficiency of (A + B) = 36 ÷ 4 = 9 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of B = 36 ÷ 36 = 1 unit/day.

⇒ Efficiency of A = Efficiency of (A + B) − Efficiency of B

⇒ Efficiency of A = 9 − 1 = 8 units/day.

⇒ Double the work = 36 × 2 = 72 units.

⇒ Time taken by A to do 72 units = 72 ÷ 8 = 9 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 9, which is option (1).**

questions.question: {Simplify } (2x - 1)² - (x - 4)(x + 4)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Expand both parts using algebraic identities:

(2x − 1)² → 4x² − 4x + 1

(x − 4)(x + 4) → x² − 16

Combine results: (4x² − 4x + 1) − (x² − 16)

Simplified form: 3x² − 4x + 17

**∴ Answer = 3x² − 4x + 17**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (2x − 1)² − (x − 4)(x + 4)

**Formula used:**

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

(a − b)(a + b) = a² − b²

 (2x − 1)² 4x² − 4x + 1 − (x − 4)(x + 4) x² − 16 Result: 3x² − 4x + 17 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Expansion of first part: (2x)² − 2(2x)(1) + (1)² = 4x² − 4x + 1

⇒ Expansion of second part: (x)² − (4)² = x² − 16

⇒ Subtracting second from first: (4x² − 4x + 1) − (x² − 16)

⇒ 4x² − 4x + 1 − x² + 16

⇒ (4x² − x²) − 4x + (1 + 16)

⇒ 3x² − 4x + 17

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

questions.question: The cost of a washing machine is 40% less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by 51% and that of the TV decreases by 15%, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 5 washing machines and 7 TVs?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of total investment (5 WM : 7 TV) = (5 × 60) : (7 × 100) = 3 : 7.

Net percentage change = [Ratio₁ × Change₁ + Ratio₂ × Change₂] ÷ Total Ratio.

Net change % = [3 × 51 + 7 × (−15)] ÷ (3 + 7) = (153 − 105) ÷ 10.

Net change % = 48 ÷ 10 = 4.8% (Positive indicates increase).

**∴ Answer = Increase by 4.8%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Cost of WM = 40% less than TV. WM quantity = 5, TV quantity = 7. WM price increase = 51%, TV price decrease = 15%.

**Formula used:**

Total Cost = (Price × Quantity) | Percentage Change = [(New Value − Old Value) ÷ Old Value] × 100

 5 WM (300) 7 TV (700) Initial Total = 1000 New 5 WM (453) New 7 TV (595) New Total = 1048 
• Net Increase = 4.8% 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let cost of 1 TV = 100, then cost of 1 WM = 100 − 40 = 60

⇒ Initial Total Cost = (5 × 60) + (7 × 100) = 300 + 700 = 1000

⇒ New cost of 1 WM = 60 + 51% of 60 = 60 + 30.6 = 90.6

⇒ New cost of 1 TV = 100 − 15% of 100 = 85

⇒ New Total Cost = (5 × 90.6) + (7 × 85) = 453 + 595 = 1048

⇒ Change in cost = 1048 − 1000 = 48

⇒ Percentage Change = (48 ÷ 1000) × 100 = 4.8%

**∴ The correct answer is Increase by 4.8% (Option 4).**

questions.question:
If 3 is added to the numerator of a fraction, it becomes 1, and if 4 is added to the denominator of the fraction, it becomes (4)/(5) .

What is the product of the numerator and the denominator of the original fraction?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Condition 1: Numerator + 3 = Denominator ⇒ D − N = 3

Condition 2: N / (D + 4) = 4/5 ⇒ 5N = 4D + 16

Substitute D = N + 3 into the second condition: 5N = 4(N + 3) + 16

5N = 4N + 12 + 16 ⇒ N = 28

Denominator D = 28 + 3 = 31

**∴ Answer = 868**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Fraction = N/D

(N + 3) / D = 1

N / (D + 4) = 4/5

**Formula used:**

Product = Numerator × Denominator

 Numerator (N) = 28 Denominator (D) = 31 
• N + 3 = D 
• N / (D + 4) = 4/5 Final Product = 28 × 31 = 868 

**Calculations:**

From the first condition:

⇒ (N + 3) / D = 1

⇒ D = N + 3

From the second condition:

⇒ N / (D + 4) = 4/5

⇒ 5N = 4(D + 4)

⇒ 5N = 4(N + 3 + 4)

⇒ 5N = 4N + 28

⇒ N = 28

⇒ D = 28 + 3 = 31

⇒ Product = 28 × 31 = 868

**∴ The correct answer is 868, which is option (1).**
